name: feature-dev
description: Execute an approved feature plan task-by-task with TDD: a fresh worker implements each task, an independent verifier gates it, capped fix rounds, then closing quality + acceptance reviews. Leaves the tree uncommitted for you to review. See README.md for limits.

planPath.description: Approved plan (must carry an 'Approved:' stamp), relative to the run cwd

maxFixRounds.description: Verifier-driven fix rounds per task before abort (0-5)

onlyTasks.description: Run only these task ids, e.g. ["2","3"] - continue after an abort, or stay inside the spawn budget

allowDirty.description: Proceed even though the tree already has changes outside .pi/ (passed to every auditor as pre-existing). Needed for onlyTasks continuations
